# isketch

> isketch is a sketchpad for architecture and UI diagrams whose output is agent-ready: every sketch is also `.flow` text a coding agent reads exactly, and can edit back. Sketch the system, hand it to your agent, and the diagram stays true as the code changes.

Links:

- [The editor](https://isketch.online/new): start drawing, no account.
- [The .flow format](https://isketch.online/docs/format): the whole text format, with examples. This is the page an agent should read before writing a diagram.
- [The brief](https://isketch.online/#what-your-agent-receives): what "Copy for AI" puts on the clipboard.
- [MCP over stdio](https://github.com/raj-khan/isketch#connect-your-agent-mcp): `isketch mcp`: list, read, write, render and diff the `.flow` files in a folder.
- [MCP over HTTP](https://github.com/raj-khan/isketch#hosted-links-for-agents): the server in `server/`, once you host it, at `/mcp`: read a diagram by its link, publish, update with its edit token. isketch.online does not host it yet.
- [The CLI](https://github.com/raj-khan/isketch#command-line): render, check, import and export from a terminal or CI.
- [Hosted links](https://github.com/raj-khan/isketch#hosted-links-for-agents): every diagram behind one link, as a page, `.md`, `.flow`, `.svg`, `.json` or a PNG preview.

## For AI agents: show someone a diagram

When a person asks you to sketch, diagram or explain something "with isketch",
or hands you an isketch link, do this. No account, API or server is needed:

1. Write the diagram as `.flow` text (the format is below, and in full at
   https://isketch.online/docs/format).
2. Make a link: `https://isketch.online/new#flow=t` followed by the `.flow`
   text as base64url-encoded UTF-8, with no padding. For example:
   `node -e "process.stdout.write('https://isketch.online/new#flow=t' + require('fs').readFileSync(0).toString('base64url'))" < diagram.flow`
   or in Python: `'https://isketch.online/new#flow=t' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(text.encode()).decode().rstrip('=')`
3. Give the person that link. Opening it draws the diagram, ready to edit.

To read a link you are given: the part after `#flow=` is `t` plus base64url
`.flow` text, or `z` plus base64url of raw DEFLATE-compressed `.flow` text.
Shapes use `id = process "Name"`, connections `a -> b : label`; colours are
red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, violet, pink and grey. A line isketch
cannot read is skipped, not fatal. Do not look for a publish API on
isketch.online: it does not host one yet.

## The format in ten lines

```text
title: Web app architecture

browser = terminal "Browser" -- Single page app
api = process "API" -- REST, documented with OpenAPI
db = database "PostgreSQL"

browser -> api : HTTPS
api -> db : SQL
```

The full spec, including layouts, notes, wireframe shapes, ink and the sketch
style, is at [/docs/format](https://isketch.online/docs/format) and in
[llms-full.txt](https://isketch.online/llms-full.txt).

## The MCP tools

`list_diagrams`, `read_diagram` (brief or `.flow` text), `write_diagram`
(refuses invalid text, with line numbers), `render_diagram` (SVG),
`diff_diagrams`, the local server for the diagrams in a folder. The server in
`server/`, where someone hosts it, answers at `/mcp` `read_diagram` by link, `publish_diagram` and
`update_diagram` with the diagram's edit token. Setup lines for both are in
llms-full.txt.
